name: northstar-finance-review
title_zh: Northstar 财务底稿的逐项打勾月度复盘表
tagline_zh: 底稿里对完账的数字，别只躺在 Excel 里。它把每张表拆成一条条可勾选的月度检查项，哪项没对上、哪项是上月遗留。
tagline_en: Reconciled numbers shouldn't just sit in Excel. It splits each table into tickable monthly checks, so you see.
desc_en: Use when reviewing the Northstar Life finance starter workbook or turning its reconciled finance tables into a checkable monthly review.
why_zh: 先认底稿的表结构再谈结论，对不上的行不替你抹平，宁可标红留给你自己判。
why_en: It reads the workbook's table structure before drawing conclusions, and flags mismatched rows instead of smoothing them over.
limit_zh: 只认 Northstar Life 那套 starter workbook 的表结构，换成别家模板或自建表它读不懂。
limit_en: Only understands the Northstar Life starter workbook layout; other templates won't parse. It doesn't reconcile for you, just converts.
title_en: Northstar finance workbook turned into a checkable monthly.
